cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 104 since February 2014, first elected in a 2014 special election. Owns transportation companies in the Mobile area, including Mobile Bay Transportation. Chairs the Boards, Agencies and Commissions Committee.
cands.gaps: We found no stated positions from Wilcox on any of the issues we track, and she did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 candidate surveys. The pages we read list her committee assignments but no specific bills she sponsored or other documented actions on these issues. We found no documented stances on data centers or development, no endorsements for the 2026 race, and no reported controversies. Her birth year and any education beyond high school were not found.
